listing.name: [0.98a] The Orbiting Spoon - A Space Diner & Officer Social Mod - WIP
listing.displayName: The Orbiting Spoon - A Space Diner & Officer Social Mod
listing.summary: The Orbiting Spoon is a lightweight, text-based roleplay and campaign layer mod that adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the Persean Sector.
listing.aiSummary: Adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports with faction-specific menus and officer social interactions.

description: Adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the sector. Players can order regional food and drinks that adapt to the controlling faction's culture. Future updates plan to include subtle buffs from meals, crew rumors, and dynamic conversations with fleet officers based on their personalities.
